messages:
Marisol: thanks everyone for joining the post-all-hands follow-up. a few infra questions came up about the APAC pilot for warm pools and autoscale. putting them here so we can track owners and answers.

Priya: can we confirm the pilot scope? number of customers, models allowed, and whether it's limited to Dedicated only? customers want to opt-in list.

Aisha: ops-specific: what observability will we surface during pilot? key metrics requested: cold-start rate, queued requests, retry counts, and P95 latency per region. also need alert thresholds.

Liam: quick answers from infra side: pilot scope = up to 5 enterprise customers + 3 internal SaaS teams. Dedicated only for pilot. model set limited to rwd-llm-7b / rwd-llm-13b quantized variants to keep kernel compatibility predictable. we'll open opt-in signups via customer success.

Jesse: contractual note: pilot customers will be on a pilot addendum (no GA SLA yet). we will offer credits for pilot-related incidents and expect a short feedback loop.

Priya: rollout timing? half-day maintenance windows? timezone considerations for APAC customers?

Liam: canary starts 2025-10-18 01:00 UTC, slow ramp over 7 days. we'll run cold-start smoke tests at local business hours in APAC (08:00-18:00 JST/SIN window). ops-bot will post daily canary status.

Aisha: observability plan: we'll emit metrics to infra-metrics.apac namespace: warm_pool_fill, cold_start_rate_1m, retry_handoff_rate, preemptible_evictions. propose alerts: cold_start_rate_1m > 5% sustained for 10m, retry_handoff_rate > 2% 5m. sound reasonable?

Marisol: good start. also need a per-customer dashboard tile showing their warm_pool_hit_ratio and regional egress latency. PMs want an exported CSV for pilot reports.

Liam: agreed. infra will add dashboard panels and a short Grafana export job for weekly CSV snapshots.

Jesse: rollback criteria from legal/ops perspective: any sustained P99 spike > 3x baseline for 30m or data plane errors > 0.5% will trigger immediate rollback and customer notification. we'll formalize in the incident runbook.

Priya: client-visible behavior question: if a request is routed to another region, do we annotate the response headers so customers can see region fallback?

Liam: yes, we'll include X-Redwood-Region and X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason headers for transparency. also adding X-Redwood-WarmPool-Hit: true/false.

Aisha: ops question on preemptibles: if preemptible nodes are used, what's the retry window and how do we surface retries in metrics?

Liam: retry window = 60s for pilot. retries increment retry_handoff_rate metric with labels (from_lane, to_lane, preemptible=true/false).

Marisol: communications: customer-success needs a short FAQ + pilot expectations doc (what we test, what customers should monitor, who to contact). can CS draft and we'll review?

Jesse: sales/legal will prepare the pilot addendum. CS, please include links to dashboards and the rollback policy.

Priya: action items recap: 1) infra (Liam) -> add metrics + headers, implement warm_pool_hit metric, and set alerts. 2) ops (Aisha) -> dashboards + CSV export + alert playbook. 3) CS (Marisol) -> FAQ and opt-in form. 4) Sales/Legal (Jesse) -> pilot addendum + credits language.

Marisol: i'll own the opt-in doc and coordinate CS comms. will post a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Liam: i'll open a runbook PR with exact metric names and the header schema. will link when ready.

Aisha: i'll spin up dashboard templates and link in the runbook.

ops-bot: Canary notice: APAC warm-pool pilot canary window 2025-10-18 01:00 UTC -> 2025-10-25 01:00 UTC. Status page: https://status.redwood.example/canaries/apac-warmpool-2025

Jesse: thanks all  let's keep daily standups for the canary week. i'll schedule a 15m sync each morning to triage any customer feedback.

Priya: thanks team  I'll wait for the runbook PR and dashboard links. tagging PMs in the roadmap doc so they can approve the pilot scope.

Marisol: closing loop here. please post updates in this thread so CS can reference later. :white_check_mark:
